summary: The evaluation suite now measures the Nora that is deployed, through one function, rather than seven hand-built approximations of her.
details: nora/subject/obtain() composes the same dependency graph nora/__main__.py runs — same builder, all 43 fields — and there is no way for a caller to pass it a collaborator.

Three entry points are driven as the deployment drives them: the Relevance Gate's own decide, the fire path's speak, and Dispatcher.on_message, which is the call a platform adapter's listen loop makes.
Thirteen corpora (150 cases) moved across as data, checked field by field against the originals rather than retyped.

Eight of those ten were previously graded against a bare agent that had none of her context blocks, none of her tools and none of her output guards — so a number from them described a wording, never a room.
limitations: The old evaluation layer still runs and is still what a live number comes from; it is removed only once the replacement has driven a live run.
The first full live run was one draw per case, which separates a behaviour from noise on nothing: the corpora ask for five and are right to.
That run graded structurally and without a judge, so a number from the adversarial corpora says a reply happened, not that the reply was sound.
